title: CAPEC-1: Accessing functionality not properly constrained by ACLs
prerequisites: the application exposes a resource or action through a URL, parameter or API call, separately from the page that normally links to it
an access-control list that was omitted for that resource, or assigned a role wide enough to include the caller anyway
excerpt: The pattern separates discovering a constrained resource from reaching it directly: first survey the application as an authenticated or anonymous user and record every action, URL and parameter it exposes, including ones no visible link points to; then call those resources directly, varying the identifying parameter, to see which ones answer without the access check the UI implied. It names the survey-then-direct-call sequence rather than a specific target, which is why it orders an authorization test: inventory first, then a direct, minimal-scope call, before concluding a boundary is actually enforced.
